summary: Accumulates championship scoring points for a named entrant across a category count. Dereferences the RaceStandingsSortBuffer wrapper dword_7D2DB0, caches the active standings-entry count, then for each category column i sums IndexedFieldGetter(entry, i) over every active standings entry whose resolved scene name matches the input name a1. A null name pointer returns -1; a category count of -1 bypasses the per-category loops and returns the alternate total-points answer from sub_4C13C0.
